motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Color, opacity, and dialog state transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary command with a stable touch target.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: hsl(158 62% 27%); color: white; font: 500 14px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: hsl(158 62% 24%); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(158 62% 32%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action on a clear surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid hsl(150 12% 86%); border-radius: 8px; background: white; color: hsl(150 18% 13%); font: 500 14px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: hsl(150 12% 94%); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(158 62% 32%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Compact labeled input for credentials and domains.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 280px; height: 44px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid hsl(150 12% 82%); border-radius: 8px; background: white; color: hsl(150 18% 13%); font: 400 14px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: hsl(150 18% 65%); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: hsl(158 62% 32%); outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px hsl(158 62% 32% / 0.2); }

components.name: Count Badge
components.description: Quiet numeric context beside the page title.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; height: 24px; align-items: center; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: hsl(150 12% 94%); color: hsl(150 20% 18%); font: 500 12px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Certificate Card
components.description: Responsive record surface used below the desktop breakpoint.
components.css: .ds-cert-card { width: 340px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 10px; background: white; color: hsl(150 18% 13%); box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(16,35,25,0.07); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-cert-card h3 { margin: 0; padding: 16px; font-size: 16px; } .ds-cert-card div { display: grid; gap: 8px; padding: 16px; border-block: 1px solid hsl(150 12% 86%); } .ds-cert-card small { color: hsl(150 6% 42%); } .ds-cert-card code { margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 12px; } .ds-cert-card footer { padding: 12px 16px; color: hsl(0 68% 47%); text-align: right; } .ds-cert-card:focus-within { outline: 2px solid hsl(158 62% 32%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Top Navigation
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; height: 64px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid hsl(150 12% 86%); background: white; color: hsl(150 18% 13%); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav button { height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: inherit; } .ds-nav button:hover { background: hsl(150 12% 94%); } .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(158 62% 32%); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: AutoSSL is a compact administrative surface where clarity outranks decoration. It uses a cool near-white workspace, crisp white work surfaces, and a restrained green accent to make certificate actions easy to scan and verify. The interface should feel calm, trustworthy, and direct.
keyCharacteristics: Compact operational density with generous touch targets.
Green is reserved for identity, focus, and primary actions.
Certificate URLs remain visible, selectable, and paired with explicit copy actions.
Destructive actions are red, secondary, and always confirmed.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Operational green is the only positive accent; do not introduce competing brand colors.

rules.name: The Compact Type Rule
rules.body: Keep operational labels and table content small enough to scan while preserving readable line height and 44px controls.

rules.name: The Flat Workspace Rule
rules.body: Do not wrap page sections in decorative cards. Reserve elevation for actual records, forms, and modal content.

dos: Do keep primary workflows on one page and make their current state obvious.
Do preserve 44px control targets, keyboard focus, semantic labels, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do switch records to cards below 1024px so all actions remain discoverable.
Do show copyable certificate URLs; scripts are the intended consumer.
donts: Don't add certificate download buttons to the console.
Don't expose API bearer tokens or call administrative Go endpoints from browser code.
Don't add a sidebar, marketing hero, decorative gradients, or nested cards.
Don't use green for deletion or red for routine status.
